activity.role: Daimyo and head of the Shimazu
activity.notes: Shimazu Yoshihisa inherited leadership in 1566 and expanded the Shimazu territorial authority across much of Kyushu. His independent Sengoku expansion ended with submission to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587. Consistent with ATLAS handling of Oda, Uesugi and Takeda, the clan itself is not treated as a state.

sources.title: Shimazu Yoshihisa — Kotobank
sources.citation_text: Kotobank states that Yoshihisa inherited Shimazu leadership in 1566, expanded across Kyushu, and submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587.
